utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Any word yet on the repair drive, Oren? I need the list and plan when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I’m sorry, I’m still gathering the list and plan. I’ll get the details to you as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. Please send it over as soon as you have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard the latest yet, but it sounds like it’s coming together. If you hear the location or any updates first, please send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll send along any location or updates as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Hana — I’m still waiting on the latest, so I appreciate you keeping me posted. If anything changes with the repair drive, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still on, but I’m a bit cautious until the timing and supplies are confirmed. If you hear anything solid, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’ll let me know as soon as the timing and supplies are locked in, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — as soon as I have the timing and supplies confirmed, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep an eye out if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — thanks, Opal. I’ll swing by Sunday at the community center and help with whatever still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks, Dane — I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday at the community center works for me — I can help spread the word and plan around school pickup and drop-off. What time are you aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m aiming for mid-morning, around 10 if that works. I’ll check around and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 works for me — I’ll spread the word and keep it around school pickup and drop-off. Let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam — quick update, the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center. I’m still collecting the list and I’ll pass it along once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — Sunday at the community center works for me. Just send me the list when it’s ready and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Sam — I’ll send the repair-drive list as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You bet, Noah — I’ll send the repair-drive list as soon as it’s ready and keep you posted on any updates.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out for the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good, Noah — I’ll get that repair-drive list over to you as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can bring a few tools—just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo. A drill, screwdriver set, and a wrench would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring a drill, screwdriver set, and wrench.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep reminding folks to drop tools, tape, screws, and spare paint by the community shed so we’re ready for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s perfect, Rosa — thanks for helping organize it. I’ll keep track of the supplies, and we’ll be ready Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful — I’ll keep reminding neighbors and make sure everything’s organized for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know the best time to stop by. Sounds like the repair drive is shaping up nicely!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. I’m still gathering the broken items and volunteers, and I’ll share the update as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Mara — thanks for keeping me posted. I’ll pass along the update once I hear the best time to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still gathering the repair list, and once it’s set I’ll repeat it to everyone. What still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. Once you’ve got the list, send it my way and I’ll help keep track of the first few homes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — once the list is set, I’ll send it your way and repeat it to everyone too. Thanks for helping keep track of the first few homes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey — it’s Sunday now at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. They could still use tools or extra supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I can bring some tools and supplies over to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s coming together nicely — folks are already pitching in with tools and supplies. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the latest updates.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess — I’ll spread the word if I hear anything new too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. I’ll pass along anything new I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal. I can help keep things organized and sort through the first few homes with you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be great, Uli — I’ve got the update now: the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Okay, Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll be there to help organize the first few homes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Eli — it’s on Sunday at the community center now, and I’m keeping everything organized there. If you can help spread the word, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Of course, Rosa — I’ll spread the word while I’m out. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Eli — I really appreciate it. If anyone asks, please tell them to head to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still haven’t heard the location for the repair drive, but I’m keeping an eye out. I’ll let you know as soon as I spot where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Nell — I’m still pulling together the list of broken items and volunteers, so I’ll share the location update as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep checking and pass along the location as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll tell folks to bring broken small appliances or furniture that needs a quick fix. Thanks, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — I’m glad it’s covered. I’ll help wherever you still need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Appreciate it, Dane — if you can, just help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I’m happy to help, I just need the details again.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair-drive list as soon as it’s ready, and I’ll keep you posted on any updates.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. Just send the list when you can, and I’ll be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Right — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now. If you can, bring tools or extra supplies and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll bring my drill and a couple clamps, plus whatever extra supplies I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Gus — that’ll be a big help. I’ll keep track of everything at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam. Could you take a look at the donation sorting and tell me what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can take a look and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it — Sunday at the community center works better for me. What time should I share with folks?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — tell folks Sunday at 2 pm at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll share Sunday at 2 pm at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still putting the list together, but I’ll repeat it to everyone once it’s set. If you know what needs fixing, tell me and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — I’ll hold off until the list is set, but if I hear of anything I’ll pass it along. Could you also share the drive plan once it’s ready?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — once the plan’s set, I’ll repeat it to everyone and share it with you too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh yeah, still on as far as I know—just waiting on the list. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, still happening as far as I know—just waiting on the list. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — send me the list when it’s ready, and I’ll keep an eye out for any items to add.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mina — I’ll send the list as soon as it’s ready. We’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, so I’ll let you know the drop-off details once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — Sunday at the community center works. Send me the drop-off details when you have them, and I’ll spread the word.
